name: smwgraphics-super-mario-world-styled-desert
title: Super Mario World Styled Desert
description:
Custom desert tileset composed of a foreground made by Evan.F on MFGG, and a background made by kojimkj originally for use with SMBX.

It also includes the gradient seen on the pink sky version of the background, to be used with UberASMTool, but using it is not required.

Also I included two semisolid platforms ripped from SMM2 that weren't present in the original tileset. They weren't taken from Dan's rip, I ripped them myself, and that's because the requester wanted them along with these graphics.

Use this block to make the quicksand work.

Requested by Julintendo.

Quick edit: Removed a few duplicate tiles from the map16.
Edit 2: Now includes BG map16.
